verified_2026_10_26.claim: The chain contains issuer and subject DNs, time validity, public key, and signature algorithm; an issuer CA needs basicConstraints cA TRUE, and keyCertSign if KU present
PEM CERTIFICATE armor contains base64 DER data
PSS parameters include message hash, MGF1 hash, salt length and trailer
ECDSA WebCrypto signatures use P1363 concatenation of r and s
Ed25519 certificate public key algorithm identifier has no parameters

scope_limits: Distinguished names compared as exact DER (conservative; semantically equivalent but differently encoded names may appear mismatched).
No hostname/SAN, EKU, name constraints, certificate policy processing, algorithm strength policy, revocation or trusted roots.
Unsupported signatures (e.g. DSA, Ed448), PSS with different MGF digest, and unknown critical extensions cannot be treated as verified.
Browsers require HTTPS or localhost for WebCrypto.
Tests include synthetic public certificates; time-dependent certificate validity is deliberately handled separately.
